provenance.graph_diagonal_proof: The exact QQ Groebner basis of the slice Jacobian plus all basic Casimirs is the coordinate maximal ideal. Hence the scalar-current graph HL diagonal is the reduced point.
provenance.independent_reference: The slice is transverse to the associated orbit itself, so its reduced intersection is a point.

provenance.scope: Exact HL diagonal equals 1. Does not extend Macdonald or certify its jump.
